notes.title: Project Rebirth has officially launched on Steam!
notes.notes:
The wait is over!

[b]Project Rebirth[/b] has launched on Steam. 

After months of development, this survival horror game is set to deliver an intense and immersive experience, blending mystery, puzzles, and terrifying zombies in an abandoned prison.

With a focus on survival and discovery, players will navigate this abandoned prison’s deadly halls and discover its dark secrets. 

Wishlist now and stay tuned for sneak peeks, updates, and more!

Have fun and try not to get scared! :)

notes.title: The Countdown Begins: Project Rebirth is coming in 24 hours!
notes.notes:
The countdown begins! 
[b]Project Rebirth[/b] officially launches tomorrow! 
Will you have what it takes to escape this abandoned prison, or will you die trying?

Don’t miss out—wishlist and follow the game now to get notified the moment it’s live. 
Be among the first to play and leave a review to share your thoughts on the game. 

See you at launch day!
